Definition: the almond (tree or nut; as being the earliest in bloom)
BiblicalUsage: An almond rod in Jeremiah's hand was a sign that God watches over His word. Jeremiah said, I see a rod of an almond tree, and Jacob sent almonds down to Egypt with the best fruits of the land. Aaron's rod budded and brought forth almonds in the tabernacle, and the almond was the first tree to bloom.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that an almond rod means God is watching, because the almond wakes first in the spring and His word does not sleep.
